steps.note: Going from View to Edit on a five minute recording with captions spent about 180ms building the panel, the tool bar and the timeline in one pass, so the slide-in stuttered before it started (2026-09-28). Built over a few passes after the slide instead, they came in up to 0.7s after the key (2026-09-30). Now the tool bar and the tracks are built behind the player, out of sight, while the window sits in View, so Cmd-2 builds nothing for them and they come in with the slide; the panel slides in with them and fills a section a pass once it lands. The walk fails if any pass after Cmd-2 or Cmd-1 runs past 100ms, or if the tool bar or the tracks are still arriving 0.35s after the key.
A moment after opening, Edit's tool bar and tracks are built out of sight behind the player
Cmd-2: the editor comes in without a hitch

Filmed both ways. Into Edit, the slide itself (its first 330ms) never sits still for 30ms: building the tracks and the panel while it moved left it 8 or 9 pictures, 90 to 120ms apart (2026-09-30), so the rest of the editor waits for it to land. Back to View is filmed for comparison and claims nothing.
